# Code of Conduct

## Our pledge

We want a respectful and welcoming environment for everyone who takes part in this project, regardless of experience, background, identity or belief.

## Expected behavior

- Treat people with respect and courtesy.
- Accept constructive criticism with maturity.
- Focus on what is best for the project.

## Unacceptable behavior

- Insults, personal attacks, harassment or discrimination.
- Publishing other people's private information without permission.
- Any conduct that would be considered inappropriate in a professional setting.

## Enforcement

The maintainer may remove comments, issues and PRs that violate this code and block those who do not comply.

## Reporting

Send reports to cristian.aob@gmail.com. All reports will be handled confidentially.
